bio_html: Alex Bell is an Assistant Professor in the Department of Economics at Georgia State University's Andrew Young School of Policy Studies and a Research Affiliate of CESifo and IZA@LISER. His research in labor economics focuses on inequality, innovation, and job choice, with particular emphasis on the measurement and pricing of non-wage job amenities. His published work has appeared in leading economics journals, including the American Economic Review and the Quarterly Journal of Economics.
